scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a stadium R&B concert, [X] crosses a large car park, climbs concrete ramps and steep stairs, and then stands and dances for hours, comparing broken-in footwear by whether it stays secure without creating a new pressure point or needing attention in the crowd.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加体育场 R&B 演唱会时，[X]需要穿过大型停车场、走混凝土坡道和陡峭楼梯，再连续站立跳舞数小时，因此会比较已经磨合过的候选鞋能否保持稳固，又不制造新的压点或在人群中频繁调整。
examples: testing Lace-Up tension before leaving the car
checking whether a Zipper or Buckle can stay closed through stairs and dancing
using Slip-On, Dial, Drawstring, or Hook and Loop only when the same movement test still provides reliable hold

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a brown dress already owned, [X] shops for white garden-wedding footwear but rejects the first broad set because wide feet must enter without pinching while the pair still holds steadily on grass through prolonged standing and celebration.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]已有一条棕色礼服，正在寻找白色花园婚礼鞋，却因宽脚和不夹脚的要求否定第一轮宽泛建议，同时要求候选鞋在草地上长时间站立和庆祝时仍能稳定贴合。
examples: using Buckle or Hook and Loop straps to change the opening and forefoot room
distributing pressure through Lace-Up, Dial, or Drawstring tension instead of tightening one point
accepting Slip-On or Zipper entry only after the opening and heel hold pass a walk test

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the wedding party fixes army-green suits and a formal dress code, [X] narrows black footwear by whether its opening and visible hardware preserve the agreed level of polish while remaining wearable through the ceremony and reception.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 婚礼团队确定军绿色西装和正式着装要求后，[X]会按鞋口结构与可见五金能否维持约定的精致程度，并在典礼和宴会全程保持可穿性，来缩小黑色鞋款范围。
examples: choosing Lace-Up Oxfords when traditional formality is decisive
using Slip-On loafers when their shape and finish still meet the dress code
considering Buckle, Zipper, Dial, Drawstring, or Hook and Loop only if the same formal silhouette remains credible

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a breathable summer footwear capsule for long Italian cobblestone days, [X] compares a walking pair and an airy pair by how easily each can be adjusted in heat, how firmly it holds on uneven streets, and whether the construction remains comfortable rather than plasticky.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季漫长的鹅卵石路行程搭建透气鞋履组合时，[X]会比较步行鞋与凉爽鞋款在炎热环境下的可调节性、崎岖路面的稳固度，以及结构是否舒适而非塑料感明显。
examples: using Lace-Up or Dial on the walking pair for adjustable hold
choosing Buckle, Drawstring, Zipper, or Hook and Loop on the airy pair when repeated adjustment remains practical
keeping Slip-On for long routes only when it stays secure on cobblestones

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon reunion on a former college campus, [X] keeps returning to familiar classic molded clogs and checks whether their effortless entry and comfort can still make a sweater-and-dark-jeans outfit look deliberate after cleaning.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备参加母校下午举行的非正式同学聚会时，[X]始终想穿惯常喜欢的经典一体成型洞洞鞋，并检查这种轻松穿脱与熟悉舒适感在清洁后能否仍让毛衣和深色牛仔裤的组合显得有意搭配。
examples: keeping Slip-On entry because familiarity and comfort matter most
comparing the selected pair with a more secured Lace-Up or loafer alternative
not inventing Buckle, Dial, Zipper, Drawstring, or Hook and Loop hardware on the known clog

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While refining a comic protagonist from a sheltered village into an outsider navigating a geometric city, [X] uses soft, manually wrapped footwear as a recurring drawing cue that must communicate rural origin, remain recognizable in motion, and stay consistent across panels.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把漫画主角从封闭村落里的少年细化为穿行几何都市的外来者时，[X]会把柔软、手工缠绕的鞋履作为反复出现的绘画线索，要求其传达乡村出身、在动作中仍可辨识且跨分镜保持一致。
examples: using Lace-Up wrapping as part of the village silhouette
treating Drawstring-like cord tension as a repeated continuity detail
rejecting Slip-On, Buckle, Dial, Zipper, or Hook and Loop substitutions that contradict the established design

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While coordinating footwear with a pink floral graduation dress, [X] asks whether raised platforms will work and commits to a strappy pair whose ankle fastening must keep the foot stable during prolonged standing and walking without competing with the dress's ruffles and jewelry.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为粉色花卉毕业礼服搭配鞋履时，[X]会确认厚底高跟是否合适，随后选定绑带款；其踝部闭合既要在长时间站立和步行中稳住脚，也不能与礼服荷叶边和首饰争抢视觉重点。
examples: using Buckle adjustment to secure the selected ankle strap
checking the fastening after a short walk rather than only in a mirror
not substituting Lace-Up, Slip-On, Dial, Zipper, Drawstring, or Hook and Loop unless the selected strappy construction actually supports it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a Kyoto day moving through several temples, traditional restaurants, and tatami spaces, [X] expects to remove and replace walking footwear repeatedly, making entry friction, heel hold after rewearing, and the time needed to resume the route selection criteria.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在京都一天内穿行多座寺庙、传统餐厅和榻榻米空间时，[X]预计会反复脱下再穿上步行鞋，因此会把穿脱阻力、重新穿好后的跟部固定，以及恢复行程所需时间作为选鞋标准。
examples: using Slip-On for repeated thresholds
using Zipper, Hook and Loop, Buckle, Drawstring, Dial, or simplified Lace-Up only when re-entry remains quick
checking that easier operation still gives enough hold for the next walking segment

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week at a managed forest camp, [X] plans a broken-in waterproof trail pair for hikes and chores and a lighter recovery pair around camp, comparing secure setup before rough ground with quick entry that does not carry mud into rest periods.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为期一周的管理式森林营地中，[X]会准备一双已经磨合的防水徒步鞋用于远足和杂务，再备一双较轻的营地恢复鞋，比较踏上崎岖地面前仔细系紧鞋子与休息时快速穿脱且不把泥带入营地的需求。
examples: using Lace-Up, Dial, Buckle, or Hook and Loop before trail sections
using Slip-On, Zipper, or Drawstring around camp when rapid changes matter
keeping loose components controlled during brush and cooking chores

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For everyday commuting and school sports, [X] compares three sneaker constructions, judging whether easy entry is worth reduced ankle structure and whether a more secured pair remains comfortable enough through both classes and activity.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了兼顾日常通勤和校内运动，[X]会比较三种运动鞋结构，判断方便穿脱是否值得牺牲部分踝部支撑，以及固定更强的鞋能否在上课和活动全程保持舒适。
examples: choosing Slip-On when easy daily entry is the priority
using Lace-Up, Dial, Drawstring, or Hook and Loop when adjustable hold matters for sport
considering Buckle or Zipper only when the actual sneaker construction and both recurring contexts support them
